evidence: Row 25 is a source/prompt requirement. Direct workbook reading confirms Quality Checks row 26 and Internal Quality Checks row 26 require live browser evidence instead of source, memory or first paint. All five frozen prompt.md files begin with http://localhost:3000 and Playwright MCP (line 1, with gate tool name continued on line 2); every corresponding judge.toml declares the Playwright MCP and resolves prompt.md. All five contain {app_context} and {criteria}; tests/test.sh:198-200 substitutes the shared context. Explicit implementation-inspection bans appear at gates/render/prompt.md:6-10, gates/constraints/prompt.md:6-11, scored/functional/prompt.md:7, scored/polish/prompt.md:5-9 and scored/visual/prompt.md:5-9 (all paths relative to the frozen task). The allowed editor source is user-authored product data; Functional:7 and Render:10 expressly say reading it does not prove execution. First-paint/source counterexample analysis: a handsome static shell with dead Run or copied string literals cannot meet gates/render/judge.toml:25, which requires a fresh calculated result after an actual authored Run in both preview and console. A localStorage-only save cannot meet gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-27, which requires a successful UI save followed by independent clean-context library retrieval of its exact fields from server data. Functional:9-13,100,112 requires actual per-outcome observations and the full browser scenario plan; its S15:376 requires actual console expansion rather than reading fixture text, S23:440-446 requires real dirty editors rather than replay-only UI inference. Polish:45-49 requires a saved control and actual keyboard traversal. Visual:42-56 requires multiple rendered surfaces at desktop and mobile, supports each score with observed evidence, and forbids fabricating views. No prompt authorizes implementation-based or memory-based credit. Conforming-alternative analysis: a server-rendered library without a JSON endpoint is explicitly accepted (Functional:5; Constraints judge:27); native/composite keyboard controls and standard escape behavior are accepted (Polish:45-49); a drawer library and legitimate empty states remain valid rendered evidence (Visual:42-43). These alternatives are not falsely excluded by the browser instructions. Raw audit: per-row-review/evidence/25/source-audit.json verifies all 81 frozen/policy hashes and all 60 raw-index artifact hashes; it records the workbook cells and five prompt/MCP inventories. Hash verification does not validate index observations. No configured judge or browser runtime was run for this source-only row; this Pass establishes the written browser-evidence contract, not actual judge compliance, grades, duration, Oracle/Luna scores or portal acceptance.
